message: 拾う門にも福来たる

name: Nanaka
message: 「Blue skies!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A wide-open sea!」

name: Misa
message: 「Neither of those is here.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I really do think the academy ought to build an ocean too, you know.」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmmmm... That might be a tiny bit impossible~」

name: Synn
message: 「Just a tiny bit?\s01」

name: Misa
message: 「We didn't come here to go swimming at the beach.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You mean to say someone out there has sent a request to Angelic Agent!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Neither of those is here.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How disappointing.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nobody even knows about the Angel Brigade in the first place, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「Exactly. That's why we need to make our name known!」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Are you planning to do something bad? Thump-thump」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, as the saying goes, bad deeds run the Great Wall of China.」

name: Misa
message: 「No, they don't!」

name: Ria
message: 「Does that mean we're going to let everyone know about us?」

name: Misa
message: 「You really are the one who understands me best, Senpai\s04」

name: Misa
message: 「You guys should follow her example!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So we're doing sales rounds, eh?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sales, you say... Hmm, hmm. Does that mean doing 'bid-rigging' with favored clients, spreading 'bad-mouthing' about competitors, and playing 'pachinko' while pretending to work?」

name: Misa
message: 「We will do no such thing!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Pretty scheming for an angel, aren't ya?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I was merely reading what was written down, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「Instead of just cramming knowledge into your head, you really have to experience it firsthand.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're going to play pachinko!!」
And so, we decided to start promotional activities for Angelic Agent.

name: Misa
message: 「We accept all manner of help requests. Please do call upon Angelic Agent♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm-hmm, I see. So this is what they call a business smile」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, knock it off」

name: Misa
message: 「How rude. I'd prefer you say I'm just being my usual self」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's rich enough to boil tea in my bellybutton」

name: Synn
message: 「Greetings are fundamental. You can never be too approachable, after all」

name: Misa
message: 「Maybe I shouldn't do this after all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, you sound super shady!」

name: Synn
message: 「You guys are so mean!」

name: Ria
message: 「Anyway, let's go do the real thing~♪」

name: Misa
message: 「W-W-Whelcome--」
Why are you biting your tongue all of a sudden.

name: Ria
message: 「Relax, relax」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You'll be fine if you just do it like we practiced」

name: Synn
message: 「You got this~」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I know that!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Why am I the only one getting snapped at……?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There, there, Madam President」

name: Misa
message: 「We accept all manner of help requests. Please do call upon Angelic Agent♪」
With Misa leading the way flashing smiles all around, we make the rounds through all the sports clubs on the field.

name: Synn
message: 「A yellowtail!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa there, is that the softball club?」

name: Ria
message: 「It's a rubber ball. That's the lacrosse club」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, another one came flying over」

name: Paqy
message: 「Way off the mark」
As my consciousness fades, I can faintly hear a voice saying, 'I'm sorry.'

name: Misa
message: 「That's it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh! Did you come up with a brilliant idea?」

name: Misa
message: 「I wonder if we could get some kind of request from the lacrosse club as an apology」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, your death will not be in vain!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Have a safe trip~」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm back」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That was fast!」

name: Ria
message: 「Did you get a request?」

name: Misa
message: 「Well, about that--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kabala!」

name: Misa
message: 「Aah, Paqy-san!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Man, this one flew all the way out here too」

name: Ria
message: 「At this rate, just finding the balls looks like it'll be tough」

name: Misa
message: 「Senpai, that's exactly it」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh?」

name: Misa
message: 「What they asked us to do is, in a word, ball-picking!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Picking them up!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Waaah!! Don't startle me like that」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright. Let's do our best and pick 'em up」

name: Nanaka
message: 「After all, as they say, there's good fortune in what you pick up... or something like that」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see... So it's a case of 'fortune comes to those who pick things up,' is it?」

name: Ria
message: 「I sure hope it comes to us~」

name: Misa
message: 「Listen up! Our request this time is to find every single one of the lacrosse club's balls on the school grounds」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, was that another grand slam just now?」
A rubber ball sails effortlessly high over our heads. Their complete lack of control is almost refreshing.

name: Paqy
message: 「Before doing this, I think they ought to train that team so they can actually play a match.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why not just turn them into the shot-put club instead!」

name: Misa
message: 「What are you saying? This is our memorable debut job, after all!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's right! You should try anything at least once!」

name: Misa
message: 「Exactly. Quit complaining and let's get started!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm completely worn out~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So weak!」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, she did sprint off really fast at the start.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Fast isn't everything, you know.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Besides, no matter how many I pick up--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Fore!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's what makes picking them up so worthwhile.」
I part the grass and squint closely.

name: Synn
message: 「Got one!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, that one belongs to the tennis club.」
Everyone really needs to take better care of their club equipment.

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, found one!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ooh!」

name: Ria
message: 「Trash spotted~♪」

name: Ria
message: 「'You have to throw your trash properly into the trash can!'」

name: Ria
message: 「'Here, trash-you very much\s04'」

name: Lolotte
message: 「By the way, where did the Vice President who suggested this go?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, she's not here. Don't tell me she's slacking off!」

name: Misa
message: 「Who's slacking off, you say?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Eek, it's the grass-covered tengu monster!」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, jeez. You're completely covered in grass」
Ria-senpai pats the grass off Misa's butt.

name: Misa
message: 「Here are my spoils for the time being」
Misa had gathered about twelve lacrosse balls.

name: Misa
message: 「Do I look like I was slacking off to you?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Perish the thought」

name: Synn
message: 「Not bad」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So you want a \{second|\s12} helping that badly, Vice President」

name: Misa
message: 「I do not!」

name: Ria
message: 「You really don't need to hold back, you know」

name: Misa
message: 「By the way. Just how many did you gather, Sakura-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「Zero for me」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Instead, I got ten softballs」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmm~」

name: Synn
message: 「Nine soft tennis balls. Two basketballs and one volleyball. Plus forty-one golf balls」

name: Synn
message: 「And--」

name: Misa
message: 「Enough, I get it already!」

name: Synn
message: 「Picking stuff up sure is fun」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, good for you」

name: Misa
message: 「Grrrr... If only I'd kept clubs other than lacrosse in mind!!」
I actually think it's pretty impressive that you only found those rubber balls, though.

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun. Let's have a contest... to see who can pick up more dropped stuff!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I won't hand over the good fortune.」
And so, the two of them began army-crawling forward.

name: Nanaka
message: 「As if doing that would actually bring good fortune.」

name: Ria
message: 「Not necessarily, you know? If fewer supplies get used up, we can keep the budget lower too.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What...!」

name: Ria
message: 「That way, we might be able to allocate the budget to other things.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Rolo-chan, we can't let them beat us either!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz... zzz...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't get smart with me. Come on, let's go!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I didn't say anything~~~.」
And thus, the entire Student Council picked up every single thing on the field.
